Messages.Author: AL
Messages.Body:
The following scenario happens: Carna, the Princess Witch gets Charnas
the Imp. She can not damage it but burning is not damaging. So Carna
can eat the hapless demon who took the wrong target to molest, right?

-Antero

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. Likewise, Virgil could eat Charnas if Charnas were placed on him (and

gain blood equal to Charnas's life).

Similarly, if Charnas is placed on Marcus Vitel, he can take an action to
burn it.

Also, if Charnas's "host" has Serpentis or Temporis, he is free to
Kiss of Lachesis Charnas away.

A Tzimisce "host" could also feed Charnas to a War Ghoul he recruits.
